title: Black-box observation record
description: A serialised record of a black-box experiment: independently constructed inputs run against MATLAB used strictly as an oracle, with observed value, class and dimensions. Contains no documentation text (constitution.md §3, §6).

release.description: MATLAB release the observations were taken on, e.g. 'R2026a'.

version_string.description: Optional full version string as reported by the oracle (e.g. output of version).

generated_by.description: Path to the experiment script that produced this record.

case.description: One experimental call. Inputs are described independently; do not copy documented examples.

description.description: Plain-language description of what this case exercises.

call.description: The exact call expression evaluated, as text (e.g. 'median([1 2 3 4])').

inputs.description: Optional structured description of the independently constructed inputs (class, size, values).

errored.description: True if the call raised an error.

error_identifier.description: MATLAB error identifier, if the call errored (e.g. 'MATLAB:...').

error_message_summary.description: Short, factual paraphrase of the error condition. Do not paste full proprietary message text verbatim beyond what is needed to identify the error.

tolerance.description: Numerical tolerance relevant to comparing this result, if any (absolute value or expression).

result.description: Observed output described by value, class and dimensions.

value.description: The serialised output value (number, array, string, or nested arrays). NaN/Inf serialised as strings 'NaN'/'Inf'/'-Inf' where JSON cannot represent them.

class.description: MATLAB class of the output, e.g. 'double', 'single', 'int32'.

size.description: Size vector of the output, e.g. [1, 1] for a scalar.

isreal.description: Whether the output is real (as reported by isreal).

issparse.description: Whether the output is sparse (as reported by issparse).
